newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank board meeting ends, no changes.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank board meeting ends, no changes.

text.p: A board meeting of Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, ended on Thursday with no changes announced to interest rates.
The market had not expected the Riksbank to make any moves.
The bank's repo rate, its key tool for controlling money market liquidity, stands at 4.10 percent.
Its other key rates, the deposit and lending rates, stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent, respectively.
